51900.author: jprendi
51900.body:
#### PR description:

This is a combined backport of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51101 and https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51878 to `20_0_X`. 

PR descriptions copied from the two PRs: 

This PR is a follow-up to commit https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/commit/b1bb704810849cad55a5450335844c9d6fb8897e (introduced in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/50926) and introduces various improvements for `ScoutingTrackMonitor`:

- use embedded `tk_vtxInd()` index in `Run3ScoutingTrack` for finding closest vertex
- do not early return if beam spot is not available (e.g. `ScoutingPFMonitor`)
- add histogram of track radius and z at DCA
- add more monitoring of vertices (`sumpT2`, `nTracks`, `chi2prob`, `chi2ndf`)
- include vertexing error in the `dxyErr`/`dzErr` computation

Additionally, on top of those, this PR adds missing `onlineBeamSpotProducer` to the start of `recoTrackFromScoutingMonitorSequence` in `HLTriggerOffline/Scouting/python/RecoTrackFromScoutingMonitor_cff.py`. 
It also swaps the ordering in `DQMOffline/HLTScouting/python/HLTScoutingDqmOffline_cff.py` of `hltScoutingTrackMonitor` and `recoTrackFromScoutingMonitorSequence` s.t. `recoTrackFromScoutingMonitorSequence` goes first, as `hltScoutingTrackMonitor` also consumes the online beam spot.


#### PR validation:

- successful compilation with `scram b`
- successful testing with `scram b runtests_testHLTScoutingDQMAnalyzers`
- successful testing with `scram b runtests_TestDQMOnlineClient-ngt_dqm_sourceclient`

FYI @mmusich

51967.author: jprendi
51967.body:
#### PR description:

This PR:

1) separates `hltScoutingDqmOffline` into `hltDqmScoutingAndReco` and `hltDqmOnlyScouting`, such that we could run `hltDqmOnlyScouting` for offline DQM analysis on HLT Scouting Collections without needing prompt results

2) introduces `onlinehlt4vector`, such that we can run the online hlt dqm client in an offline analysis

#### PR validation:

This PR was prepared in `CMSSW_20_0_X_2026-09-22-2300`. We can now run the workflows for example like:

```
cmsDriver.py step2 \
    -s DQM:hltDqmOnlyScouting \
    --conditions 160X_dataRun3_NGT_v6 \
    --data \
    --datatier DQMIO \
    -n 100 \
    --eventcontent DQMIO \
    --geometry DB:Extended \
    --era Run3_2026 \
    --filein "${ALL_FILES}" \
    --fileout file:step2.root \
    --nThreads 24 \
    --python_filename dqm.py \
    --no_exec


cat <<@EOF >> dqm.py
process.source.inputCommands = cms.untracked.vstring(
    'keep *',
    'drop CTPPSDiamondDigiedmDetSetVector_hltCTPPSDiamondRawToDigi_TimingDiamond_HLTX',
    'drop CTPPSPixelDigiedmDetSetVector_hltCTPPSPixelDigis__HLTX',
    'drop CTPPSRecord_hltOnlineMetaDataDigis__HLTX',
    'drop DCSRecord_hltOnlineMetaDataDigis__HLTX',
    'drop OnlineLuminosityRecord_hltOnlineMetaDataDigis__HLTX',
    'drop recoBeamSpot_hltOnlineMetaDataDigis__HLTX',
)

process.scoutingCollectionMonitor.onlineMetaDataDigis = "hltOnlineMetaDataDigis"
process.scoutingCollectionMonitor.onlyScouting = True
process.scoutingCollectionMonitor.beamSpot = cms.InputTag("hltOnlineBeamSpotFromDB")
process.ScoutingTrackMonitor.beamSpotLabel = cms.InputTag("hltOnlineBeamSpotFromDB")
@EOF
```

and 

```
cmsDriver.py step2 -s DQM:onlinehlt4vector \
	     --conditions 160X_dataRun3_NGT_v6 \
             --datatier DQMIO \
             -n 100 \
             --eventcontent DQMIO \
             --geometry DB:Extended \
             --era Run3_2026 \
             --filein $ALL_FILES \
             --fileout file:step2.root \
             --nThreads 24 \
             --python_filename dqm.py \
             --no_exec
```

with the subsequent standard harvesting.  It was tested w files produced in `16_0_X`, however when one drops the corresponding collections, this runs fine.
